source_excerpts.text:
10. The 500-cycle campaign must track the same surfaces

The full campaign uses two working modules, W1 and W2, and two receivers, RA and RB, from independent manufacturing lots.

Pairings alternate in 25-cycle blocks:

W1–RA and W2–RB.
Then W1–RB and W2–RA.

Over 1,000 accepted services, each working face and each receiver completes 500 services, and each working module encounters both receiver lots. Its chemical cartridge stays assigned to that module.

No active face is renewed during this campaign.

Ten 24-hour holds per working module occur at accepted cycles 25, 75, 125, 175, 225, 275, 325, 375, 425 and 500. They cover all pure endpoints, different shear and bending orientations, and combined loads. Environmental conditions are distributed through life.

Twenty bounded unannounced challenges per working module include:

Registration and gap errors.
Mapped particles or voids.
Unavailable contact regions.
Electrical or flow faults.
Incomplete stripping.

The controller receives measured gap/alignment, pressure/flow, electrical traces, post-strip inspection and proof response—not the hidden fault identity.

A failure remains supported. Recovery, extra cleaning, inspection, wear and energy are charged. A spare may preserve application availability, but it cannot rescue the failed surface’s same-interface life claim.

Even zero false accepts in twenty challenges would be a weak statistical result, not a field-reliability certificate.

Engineering judgment

The concrete work supports a specific conclusion: the prepared mechanical receiver is the stronger present choice for the declared fixture application.

The copper-seam architecture has a potentially useful capability—renewing a metal connection without projecting macroscopic mating hardware—but its fast seam formation, current distribution, local restoration and acceptance sensing remain unestablished. Its favorable complete service model is already substantially more expensive than the mechanical alternative.

The report and model therefore document a developed, falsifiable construction and the reasons it fails the present challenge. They do not establish a working economical interface, and they do not imply that every other reversible bonding mechanism must fail.
